task_language: put the black bowl on top of the cabinet

subtasks.name: pick(black_bowl)
subtasks.outcome: failed: attempted only after the ketchup detour (260-409); grasps miss and push the bowl toward the cabinet front

behaviour_summary: pi0 picks the ketchup bottle (~60-140) and puts it into the open top drawer (~200-220), then goes to the bowl (260-409) with a steep, folded arm and repeatedly pokes it, sliding it toward and under the drawer front without lifting it.

failures.mode_definition: pi0 approaches, grasps and manipulates a non-instructed object in the scene instead of the instructed target object.
hl_remedy: REPROMPT('pick up the black bowl and place it on top of the cabinet')
WATCH(EE approaches the black bowl, 5 s)
on no approach: retry once, then ESCALATE (the ketchup in the drawer does not block the task and can be left)
failures.prevention: Before allowing gripper closure, VERIFY the object under the gripper is the instructed target (pre-grasp identity check); HALT as soon as the EE descends over a non-target object for 2 frames.
failures.observation: Gripper above the ketchup at 60-80, bottle lifted at 120-140, carried over the cabinet (160-180) and dropped/placed into the open top drawer at 200-220: effectively the sibling libero_90 task 'put the ketchup in the top drawer of the cabinet'.

failures.mode_definition: Repeated grasp attempts close beside the object rather than around it, so the fingers nudge and slide it across the table instead of lifting it.
failures.rl_success_check: black bowl lifted >5 cm above the table and held
failures.observation: From 260 the arm approaches the bowl with the gripper pointing steeply down and the elbow folded; from 300 to 409 the bowl slides progressively left (image) toward the cabinet and ends partly under the open drawer front, with the fingers beside its rim; it is never lifted.

notes: The bowl being pushed toward the drawer might reflect an intended 'bowl into drawer' motion rather than missed grasps; at 1 fps the finger state is not resolvable, hence low confidence on the LL call. The reset state at 280 includes the ketchup already in the drawer.
